_rule: Every figure here is a public list price, a published specification or a measured value, with where it came from and when it was checked. Volumes are the modelled company's assumptions, labelled as such, and the page lets you change them.
tokenizerNote: Token counts are measured with the local model's own tokenizer (Qwen2.5). Cloud providers count with their own tokenizers; Anthropic's pricing page notes that its newer tokenizer produces approximately 30% more tokens for the same text. The cloud figures are therefore approximate, in either direction.

fx.how: ECB euro reference rates for 2026-09-28: USD 1.1378 and GBP 0.85785 per euro, so GBP per USD = 0.85785 / 1.1378

power.how: An ESTIMATE, not a meter reading: the chip's published Processor Base Power (15 W) to Maximum Turbo Power (55 W). The whole laptop draws more (screen, memory), and GPU work does not hold turbo continuously.

electricity.how: Ofgem energy price cap, GB average electricity unit rate, Direct Debit. The page states there is no VAT on electricity from 1 October 2026 to 31 March 2027.

volumes.how: MODELLED ASSUMPTIONS for a mid-sized digital bank's month — not measured, not a client's figures. Change them on the page.

hardware.how: The laptops are already owned: no new hardware is bought for this work. Wear and the staff time to set a node up are not costed here.
